metadata.description: Ursprungskraft, Occupational therapy practice in Erlangen

neurology.title: Occupational Therapy in Neurological Conditions
neurology.description: Individual treatment following stroke, multiple sclerosis, Parkinson's disease, traumatic brain injury, peripheral nerve lesions, and other neurological conditions. Focus is on restoring or compensating motor, sensorimotor, and cognitive functions as well as promoting independence and competence in daily activities.

pediatrics.title: Pediatric Occupational Therapy
pediatrics.description: Support and promotion of children and adolescents with developmental delays, sensory processing disorders, AD(H)D, autism spectrum disorder, fine and gross motor difficulties, as well as school and learning challenges. The goal is maximum independence and participation in everyday life, kindergarten, and school.

cfs.title: ME/CFS Recovery & Pacing Support
cfs.description: Very gentle, highly individualized, pacing-based occupational therapy support for Myalgic Encephalomyelitis / Chronic Fatigue Syndrome. Emphasis on energy management, realistic daily structure, prevention of Post-Exertional Malaise (PEM), gradual building of activity tolerance, and preservation or rebuilding of quality of life.
